title: Workspace Metadata
description: Freeform metadata for a workspace. The optional `repository` key binds the workspace to a git repository used by the community agent.

repository.description: Git repository bound to this workspace. Credentials (tokens, SSH keys) MUST NOT be stored here — they live only in the agent configuration.

url.description: Repository URL (https or ssh). Must not embed credentials such as https://user:pass@host/repo.
